name: root
description: a thick, pale root has pushed through the cellar wall and snakes across the floor. it's warm to the touch, and when you press your ear to it, you can hear a faint, rhythmic pulsing — like a heartbeat far beneath the earth.

params.success_message: you follow the root with your hand. it leads to a corner of the cellar where the earth has been disturbed. something was buried here. the root grows through the mound like a grave marker.
